title: ZPA Private Service Edge Release Summary (2023)

blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements released per Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) Private Service Edge version.
This ZPA Private Service Edge version includes the following updates:

blocks.item: An update was released to further improve the effectiveness of the current troubleshooting procedures available to customers.
An update was released to support redirection policy rules. To learn more, see About Redirection Policy.

blocks.text: Your ZPA Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per ZPA Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see About ZPA Private Service Edge Software Upgrades.

An optional update was released for the ZPA Private Service Edge Manager software that includes new ZPA Private Service Edge RPM packages to provide support for Redhat Enterprise Linux 7.x and 8.x. To learn more, see Understanding the Manager Software.
An update was released that includes improvements to optimize system performance.

Your ZPA Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per ZPA Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see About ZPA Private Service Edge Software Upgrades.
This ZPA Private Service Edge version includes the following updates:

blocks.item: An update was released that includes internal ZDX caching optimizations.
An update was released that provides support for inspection of an application segment from ZPA using Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA). To learn more, see Inspect with ZIA.
An update was released that prevents ZPA Private Service Edges from starting when physical memory on the VM is less than 2 GB. To learn more, see Private Service Edge Memory Requirements.
An update was released that provides support for user risk scores as a criteria type in access policy rules. To learn more, see User Risk Scores.

blocks.text: Your ZPA Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per ZPA Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see About ZPA Private Service Edge Software Upgrades.
This ZPA Private Service Edge version includes the following updates:

blocks.item: An update was released for the ZPA Private Service Edge Manager Software to support the full list of OS trusted certificate authority (CA) bundles for updating components.

An update was released for ZPA Private Service Edges to provide support for an event when the control connection disconnects for ZPA Private Service Edges. To learn more, see Viewing and Managing Events Diagnostics.
To support Adaptive Access, an enhancement was released to reevaluate access when there are changes to posture profiles. To learn more, see About Device Posture Profiles.
An update was released for Private Service Edges to support alternative cloud domains. To learn more, see Alternative Cloud Domain.

blocks.text: Your ZPA Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per ZPA Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see About ZPA Private Service Edge Software Upgrades.
An update was released for ZPA Private Service Edges to fix an issue with registration of FQDNs for client-to-client applications.

Your ZPA Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per ZPA Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see About ZPA Private Service Edge Software Upgrades.
This ZPA Private Service Edge version includes the following updates:

blocks.item: An update was released for ZPA Private Service Edges that provides support for Branch Connectors and Cloud Connectors.
An update was released for ZPA Private Service Edges that requires admins to change the default password.
An update was released for ZPA Private Service Edges to support a large number of applications.

blocks.text: Your ZPA Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per ZPA Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see About ZPA Private Service Edge Software Upgrades.

This ZPA Private Service Edge version provides support for the backup and management of disaster recovery configuration and binary snapshots. Debugging commands were also released for disaster recovery troubleshooting. To learn more, see About Disaster Recovery ZPA Private Service Edge Groups, Managing Disaster Recovery Configuration and Binary Snapshots, and Troubleshooting ZPA Private Service Edges.

Your ZPA Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per ZPA Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see About ZPA Private Service Edge Software Upgrades.
This ZPA Private Service Edge version includes a fix to address an OpenSSL vulnerability.

Your ZPA Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per ZPA Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see About ZPA Private Service Edge Software Updates.
A recommended update was released for the ZPA Private Service Edge Manager Software to address an OpenSSL vulnerability. To learn more, see About the Manager Software.
This ZPA Private Service Edge version includes the following updates:

blocks.item: An update was released that provides the CPU usage for ZPA Private Service Edges in the journalctl logs every minute.
An update was released that provides country code support in policies for ZPA Private Service Edges. To learn more, see Country Code Updates and About ZPA Private Service Edges.

blocks.text: Your ZPA Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per ZPA Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see About ZPA Private Service Edge Software Upgrades.
An optional update was released for the ZPA Private Service Edge Manager software to support internal Zscaler-only cloud configurations. To learn more, see About the Manager Service.
